Author: kuchris
Name: OCBFR
Description:
OCBFR 是新月島尋寶自動化插件，提供寶箱掃描、內外環尋寶、錢幣兌換、退本重入及戰利品記錄。支援繁體中文／English 介面。需要 Daily Routines、vnavmesh 與 BOCCHI。

OCBFR automates Occult Crescent coffer scanning, treasure routes, currency purchases and re-entry, with loot tracking and a Traditional Chinese / English interface. Requires Daily Routines, vnavmesh and BOCCHI.
Punchline: 新月島尋寶自動化與戰利品記錄 / Occult Crescent treasure automation and loot tracking.
Changelog: Global 2.3.0.21：簡化介面改為自動縮放的窄條工具列，保留開始／停止、緊急停止、語言及完整介面按鈕，移除簡化介面的 Ko-fi 與資訊卡。狀態及開箱總數改以滑鼠提示顯示；編譯時自動複製 dev plugin manifest。Compact view now uses an auto-sized toolbar with start/stop, emergency stop, language and full-view controls. Removes compact-view Ko-fi and dashboard cards; status and coffer totals appear in a tooltip. Builds now copy the dev-plugin manifest beside the DLL.
